analyzy.ako_text: On A days room-based control runs as usual; on B days it is off and the pump follows only the weather-compensation curve. During the test the agent changes nothing and the safeguard stays active: if the children's room is too warm or too cold, or the pump reports an error, the B day is interrupted and control returns. On B days the rooms may be a little warmer or cooler. The test starts at the next midnight.
